title: Curious Calligraphy Cuttlefish
statement: This small, thoughtful cuttlefish drifts through an indigo library of sunken slate tablets and lamplit kelp, its skin rippling with ever-changing glyphs that look almost like handwriting but never quite repeat. When a visitor lingers at the glass, it floats closer, tilts its head as if listening, and sketches their silhouette across its body in soft gold light before writing them a flourish of something that might be a question.
